r3-evidence.finding: All cited evidence independently reproduced, non-piped, exit status read directly: full suite 1867 passed/2 skipped/829 subtests/exit 0 (matches claim exactly, my own run took 487s); verifier 9/9 exit 0; self-test 9/9 rejections exit 0; RED repro exit 1 NOT reproduced with all 3 pre-asserts OK; close-side probe exit 0, 3/3 moves as claimed; DC4 neighbour probe exit 0; anti-vacuity exit 5 on empty pattern and exit 0 on real pattern (34 passed). Neither gap undermines THIS run's actual verdict: the real session ids are genuinely distinct random hex (acc-89f734 / acc-7f3d1b, no case games), and the real nonce-transfer claim is independently confirmed by direct count (not solely by V8) -- A's log 0, roundtrip.md-pre-B 0, spine.json 2 legitimate why-records, B's log 1 -- reproduced myself both via git-tracked grep and a full working-tree walk, both giving identical counts. r6-fowler.title: Refactoring pass (Fowler code smells)
r6-fowler.imperative: Run the refactoring / code-smell pass (SKILL.md 'Refactoring pass'). Render a verdict on each Fowler baseline smell (long method, large class, duplicated code, feature envy, data clumps, primitive obsession, long parameter list, shotgun surgery, divergent change, message chains, speculative generality, comments-as-deodorant): flagged / overridden / absent. Smells are judgment calls, ALWAYS subordinate to the repo's documented standards -- an override needs a logged standard + reason. Record the pass to templates/FOWLER_PASS.template.json, run scripts/verify_fowler_pass.py <record> (it refuses a skipped smell or an unlogged override), then record pass/fail with a finding. Do NOT silently skip this item.
